SourceOnly v1. Base W HEAD supplied by Main: 769ff3f11133a972bb9f7a78bb4a4cf52d52dcaf. Registry v178: 854. R318/R319/R323/R331/R335 reviewed.
NEW files only; apply patch in an isolated Main-owned checkout. No inference or producer changes.
CLI: python tools/fixed_history_logits.py comparison-manifest.json; stdout strict JSON, nonzero rejection. One manifest argument.
Manifest schema strata.fixed-history-comparison.v1: common, baseline, candidate, budget, consumer, retire_after. common contains P,N,vocab,max_context,endian(little/big),stride=1,position_convention='P-1+i predicts follow[i]', policy exactly {bos:prompt-explicit,eos:score-all-stop-off,mask:all-follow}, exact prompt_ids/follow_ids arrays and *_sha256 (compact JSON UTF8 SHA256), tokenizer/model path+sha256 pins. Each arm repeats exact common and pins capture,binary,source,runtime,receipt. Binary/source/runtime pins identify immutable artifacts or canonical bundle inventories; adapter must verify inventories describe actual execution. Budget finite max_vocab,max_rows,max_capture_bytes bounds each capture and row/aggregate memory. All follow positions scored; no masking implementation or silent subset selection.
Receipt schema strata.fixed-history-capture-receipt.v1 is a NEW adapter contract, NOT an existing production receipt claim. It binds arm capture/binary/source/runtime SHA256, exact common, complete positions, targets, observed_rows, source_provider='standalone-native-segmented-spec-follow-dump-logits', lifecycle, and pinned supervisor_evidence/fault_evidence/provider_evidence. Required lifecycle: observed/reaped/owned_processes_empty/closed/capture_close_ok/normal_exit/fault_check_complete=true; forced/canceled/deadline_hit/budget_hit=false; exit_code/fault_count=0; matching nonempty boot_before/boot_after; owned_pid and owned_start. passed=True is ignored.
Remaining prerequisite: Main must implement/review a capture receipt adapter that derives these fields from pinned existing supervisor receipts, PID/start/reap checks, same-boot fresh bounded fault windows, capture fclose/progress/row evidence, and actual segmented native spec-follow provider/build/source/runtime proof. Pinned text alone cannot prove these semantics. Comparator rejects absent adapter fields; even accepted synthetic contract evidence remains production_capture_qualified=False. Current standalone runtime remains UNQUALIFIED, serves no qualification role.
Numerics stdlib float64 per row; full-vocabulary log-softmax, forward/reverse KL, target logprob/NLL deltas, ranks, margins, means/quantiles, PPL overflow explicitly null+log_value. Quantiles linear interpolation at (count-1)*q. Ties descending logit then ascending token ID, ordinal target rank. Full float scan includes tails. No quality thresholds/adoption; held-out task quality unevaluated. Generated identities not required.
Retention consumer: Main bounded analytical validation and next explicitly named fixed-history comparison only. Raw actual captures require predeclared bytes=2*(8+4*vocab*N), owner Main, consumer run ID, next review verified metric extraction; retire via serialized retention manifest only after verification and closure. No raw production capture created here.
